verdict.rationale: LangGraph's Python/JS API (graph construction, streaming modes, persistence, interrupts, memory) is extensively documented across first-party docs, and a CLI/Agent Server exposes deployed graphs programmatically, giving AI-native users a clear, documented API surface to drive the product. Missing for 10: an explicit OpenAPI/REST spec for the deployed Agent Server (probe found only 404s) and independent confirmation of API stability, since community comments note frequent breaking changes.
